scraped.title: IT & Legal Advice GFMIS
scraped.subtitle: IT & Legal Advice for the Procurement of the GFMIS for Uzbekistan
scraped.clientName: ICON-INSTITUTE GmbH & Co. KG Consulting Gruppe Von-Groote-Straße 28, 50968 Köln, Germany
scraped.description: The project aimed to improve Public Financial Management (PFM) and accountability in Uzbekistan's budget execution process through treasury and budget preparation reforms. Its specific objectives were to ensure compliance with ADB procurement regulations and Uzbekistan's laws…
body: The project aimed to improve Public Financial Management (PFM) and accountability in Uzbekistan's budget execution process through treasury and budget preparation reforms. Its specific objectives were to ensure compliance with ADB procurement regulations and Uzbekistan's laws during the bidding process for the Government Financial Management Information System (GFMIS) and related equipment. Additionally, it focused on ensuring the technical specifications of bidding proposals matched those outlined in the bidding documents.
